rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a traffic light.

example.english: The traffic light ahead has turned red, so slow down and stop.
example.traditional: 前面個紅綠燈轉咗紅，慢慢停低呀。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 go3 hung4 luk6 dang1 zyun2 zo2 hung4 maan6 maan2 ting4 dai1 aa3

rows.note: Speakers use this term especially in official, technical, or more formal contexts.

example.english: This section of the road is temporarily closed because of a faulty traffic light.
example.traditional: 因為交通燈故障，呢段路要暫時封閉。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 gaau1 tung1 dang1 gu3 zoeng3 ni1 dyun6 lou6 jiu3 zaam6 si4 fung1 bai3
